scope: GL API handle counts, Three.js-owned canvas subscriptions and product behavior. Whole-page heap is measured independently and remains unqualified because growth is present in upstream and fork. GPU residency in bytes is not measured.
resourceTracker: Weak object/context tracking; context loss retires handles. Earlier strong-reference tracker results are excluded.
rendererListenerTracker: Only direct WebGLRenderer.js registration sites; 3 owned canvas subscriptions per renderer. Does not relabel all-page listeners as renderer-owned.
countersNote: Detailed GL counters and CPU profiling were separate from formal timing. Submitted buffer payload bytes are not physical bus bandwidth.
diagnosticCleanup: Some historical diagnostic browser shutdowns stalled after data was saved; task-owned processes were terminated. Current tools verify browser process exit before forcing harness shutdown.
